note: South African rand. The statements print millions; figures here are the full amounts. FY2026 and FY2025 are from the consolidated statement of profit or loss in the audited statements for the year ended 31 March 2026; FY2024 and FY2023 are from the same statement in the audited statements for the year ended 31 March 2024, which the 2026 report does not repeat. Revenue is the printed income line: net gaming win plus food and beverage, rooms and other revenue. Cost of sales is the printed gaming levies and Value Added Tax line, the direct levy on gaming income. Operating expenses aggregate the printed employee costs, other operating expenses, amortisation and depreciation and impairments of non-current assets, less the printed impairment reversal (10,000,000 in FY2026 and 198,000,000 in FY2023). The printed fair value adjustment of investment properties sits outside operating expenses (5,000,000 FY2026, 49,000,000 FY2025, -5,000,000 FY2024, -17,000,000 FY2023). Net finance costs are printed finance costs less printed finance income. The printed share of profit of associates sits between net finance costs and profit before tax (6,000,000 FY2026, 2,000,000 FY2025, 9,000,000 FY2024, 9,000,000 FY2023). Earnings per share is printed in cents (126, 120, 147, 167) and stored in rand. FY2022 is not carried: the group was a different reporting entity before the Tsogo Sun Hotels merger, so a 2022 column would not be comparable with these four years.
reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) holds in every year once the printed fair value adjustment of investment properties is added: FY2026 +5,000,000, FY2025 +49,000,000, FY2024 -5,000,000, FY2023 -17,000,000. Operating Profit (EBIT) - Net Finance Costs + share of profit of associates = Profit Before Tax in every year.
